Level Up with Dapostar! 

Ready to take your flow to the next level? 🌟

Coach Alok is starting Level 2 Dapostar Classes with Flowshaala! Whether you’re already practicing or looking to challenge yourself, anyone can join.

Before joining, simply send us your practice videos for an assessment by Coach Alok. This helps us understand your current level and guide you into the right class.

Level 2 covers:
✨ Wall Plane (Vertical & Horizontal)
✨ Steering & Wraps
✨ Buzzsaws & Isolations
✨ Body Rolls
✨ Infinity (4-beat)
✨ Side Flicks & Penguin Tosses
✨ Boomerangs
✨ Isolated Flower Patterns
✨ Advanced One-Hand Infinity
✨ Under-the-Leg Dribbles
✨ Infinite Dribbles & Advanced Tosses
✨ Foot Rolls & Kicks
…and much more!

If you’ve mastered the Level 1 prerequisites—or think you’re close—send us your videos and let’s get you flowing! 🔥

📩 DM us your assessment videos to secure your spot.

Classes reposting on July 5 
Every Sunday 6.30-7.30 PM 

#Flowshaala #Dapostar #FlowArts #SkillProgression #Level2 LearnToFlow

posts.caption:
Somewhere along the way, we learned to make ourselves smaller.
Quieter in the room. Softer in our opinions. Less in our bodies. Less in our joy. Less in the space we’re “allowed” to take.
Most of us didn’t even notice it happening.
This is why we created the Silk Fans Experience with Saira, a space where women come back into their bodies, their breath, their softness and their power. Where the only thing you’re asked to do is unfold.

Saira knows this path intimately. She walked it herself — finding her voice, her flow, and her freedom through the fans. Now she holds space for other women to find theirs.
No dance background needed. No “right” body. No performance. Just silk, breath, movement, and you — exactly as you are.
If something in you has been waiting to bloom — this is your sign.

Silk fans workshop and course is starting on 
🗓️May 2, Saturday 6.30-7.30 PM 
🤍 Limited to 12 women
📍 Flowshaala Center @chaosfaktory HSR layout, Bangalore 

🔗 DM us “FLOW” or message Kavya at +916366532576 to reserve your spot.
Come find your freedom.

#Flowshaala #SilkFans #WomenOfIndia #FlowArts #MovementMedicine WomensCircle SelfExpression Bangalore

This is your sign to stop admiring silk fans and start dancing with them. 🪭

I am so excited to bring all you beautiful ladies (and men) this silky smooth, beginner friendly Silk Fans course! 

Freedom with Fans is a beginner-friendly silk fans course where we learn techniques — yes — but also the feeling. 

In 4 weeks, we’ll cover all the fundamentals - grips, transitions, flow pathways - and explore how to connect your body to the prop, to the music, and to your own unique flow and elegance.

Starting 5th March
Every Thursday, 5 pm to 6 pm
Chaos Faktory, HSR Layout

Come learn with us, and find our Freedom with Fans! 

For enquiries and more details, contact +91 91873 08416

posts.caption:
@hoopwithsupriya in conversation with @shailichopra shares how the idea of fitness and wellness is evolving — with people now embracing new forms of fitness like hula hooping.

At first, many think they can’t do it, but the joy of completing it is truly beyond words.

Full interview coming soon.

#fitnessjourney #fitnessmotivation #healthjourney #womenshealth #womenfitness #hulahoop #hulahooping #hulahoopworkout

Have you ever wanted to try your hips with the hoops? 
Learning to hula-hoop is much like figuring out life. You need to find the right fit and you’d be one swirl closer to happiness! 

Supriya has gathered many feats in this 7 journey, from organising the first ever Zula Party which is a combination of Zumba and Hula-hooping, to being the first hooper at the Tilicho Lake - the highest lake in Nepal.
